en.headline: AFCD may euthanise large dog that killed two pets if owner surrenders it
en.dek: Assistant director Jackie Yip said the 60 kg mixed-breed dog remains under observation; if kept by the owner it could be declared a known dangerous dog requiring a muzzle and short leash.
body: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department may consider euthanising the large dog that killed two smaller pets near YOHO Mall in Yuen Long if its owner surrenders the animal to the government.

Assistant director Jackie Yip told a radio programme on Wednesday that authorities are discussing the dog’s future with the owner. ‘If the owner ultimately decides to hand the dog over to the government, we will determine an appropriate arrangement. If necessary, we will also consider euthanasia,’ she said.

If the owner keeps the dog, the department may apply for a court order to declare it a known dangerous dog under the Dangerous Dogs Regulation. That designation would require the animal to be muzzled and kept on a leash no longer than 1.5 metres in public places.

The roughly 60 kg mixed-breed dog remains under observation at an AFCD animal management centre. It was previously detained in July over another attack and returned after a warning. The owner was arrested on Tuesday and the two cases remain under investigation.

zh.headline: 漁護署：元朗咬斃兩犬大狗若交由政府或考慮人道處理
zh.dek: 助理署長葉恩明表示，約60公斤混種犬仍在觀察中；若狗主繼續飼養，署方或申請將其列為已知危險狗隻，須戴口罩及用短於1.5米狗繩。
body: 漁農自然護理署表示，若元朗日前咬斃兩頭小狗的大型犬最終交由政府處理，署方或考慮人道毀滅。
助理署長葉恩明周三在電台節目表示，署方正與狗主商討狗隻去向。她說：『如果狗主最終決定將狗交予政府，我們會決定合適安排。如有需要，亦會考慮人道處理。』
若狗主選擇繼續飼養，署方或申請法庭命令，將該犬列為已知危險狗隻。按《危險狗隻規例》，已知危險狗隻在公眾地方必須戴口罩，並用長度不超過1.5米的狗繩牢固控制。
該約60公斤混種犬現正於漁護署動物管理中心觀察。該犬曾於7月因另一咬傷個案被扣留後發還，當時已警告主人必須用短於兩米的狗繩。狗主周二被捕，兩案仍在調查中。
